subject.title: [Feature]: GitHub Copilot provider cannot reach GitHub Enterprise data-residency (*.ghe.com) tenants

question: Should the bundled github-copilot provider support allowlisted GitHub Enterprise data-residency tenant routing, including provider-owned config/env selection and tenant-scoped token caches?
rationale: The request fits setup reliability and major-provider support, but it changes auth-provider routing and token destinations for a bundled provider, so product and security-boundary intent must be explicit before the linked PR can close this issue.

options.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Review and harden the linked PR as the supported path for data-residency tenants while preserving default public github.com behavior.

options.title: Route GHE Copilot outside core
options.body: Reject bundled-provider tenant routing and require a separate plugin or ClawHub package for enterprise-specific behavior.

options.title: Require a generic host-routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the linked PR until maintainers define a reusable provider-auth host-routing API.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Review and harden the linked PR as the supported path for data-residency tenants while preserving default public github.com behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent current-main history across the Copilot provider/auth/runtime files and adjacent provider work.
